appHelp: Choose Game or Chat for each playing app.
offline: Headset off or out of range
defaultActive: SteelSeries Game is the default output
setDefault: Use SteelSeries Game as default output
fallbackHelp: Choose where Game and Chat play when the headset is off. They return to the headset when it turns on.
fallbackActive: Game and Chat are playing through your selected output.
wheelHelp: Center keeps both channels full. Turn toward Game or Chat to lower the other channel.
routingHelp: Assignments are remembered per application. Select SteelSeries Chat inside voice apps when available. Browser tabs share an application assignment.
noApps: Play audio to assign an application.
writeOnly: Your last applied choices are remembered. Changes made in other apps aren't detected.
lowBatteryHelp: Notify once when battery drops to 20% or below.
